name: Rye Ocean Beach
signature: The most accessible ocean beach on the Peninsula — consistent surf, easy parking, and patrolled all summer
editorNote:
Rye Ocean Beach is the Peninsula's most practical surf beach — easier to get to than Gunnamatta, more consistent than Flinders, and patrolled through the summer by Rye SLSC. The swell is genuine Bass Strait but without the full ferocity of Gunnamatta, which makes it a better choice for less experienced surfers and families who want ocean swimming rather than bay water.

The beach is long and wide, the dunes are intact, and the crowds — even in January — are manageable compared to bay beaches like Rosebud or Safety Beach. There is a cafe at the surf club worth stopping at after a swim.

Best visited on a south or south-west swell with north-west winds to clean it up. Check conditions before driving down — a 1ft beach break and a 4ft close-out are both technically 'surf' at Rye.
whyWeGo: The most accessible ocean beach on the Peninsula — the right balance of real surf and practical amenity.
ifOnlyOneThing: Check the swell forecast before you leave Melbourne. A 30-minute drive is only worth it if the conditions are right.
